title: Renewal Dating and Late Renewal of Northgate Memberships
content:
## Renewable status

On Northgate Memberships, a renewal is taken only on a membership whose status is active or expired; a suspended membership must first be reinstated by the membership office, and a cancelled or closed membership cannot be renewed and needs a new enrollment. The status is the one on the membership record.

| Status on the membership record | Renewal |
|---|---|
| active | renewed on time |
| expired | renewed back to active, dated by the late renewal rule |
| suspended | not taken until the membership office has reinstated the membership |
| cancelled | cannot be renewed; a new enrollment is needed |
| closed | cannot be renewed; a new enrollment is needed |

## On-time renewal

An active membership renewed on or before its expiry date continues without a gap: the new membership year starts the day after the current expiry date and runs the tier's length of one membership year.

## Late renewal

An expired membership is renewed back to active, and its new membership year is dated by the late renewal rule. A lapsed membership keeps its original anniversary only when the renewal fee is paid no later than the tier's anniversary period, in calendar months, after the expiry date of the lapsed membership year. Calendar months are added to the expiry date and, when the resulting month has no such day, the boundary falls on that month's last day. The boundary day itself still keeps the anniversary.

- Within that limit the new year starts the day after the lapsed expiry date, so the lapsed weeks count as part of the new year.
- Beyond it the new year starts on the date the renewal fee is paid.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Lapsed expiry date | Anniversary period | Last payment date that keeps the anniversary | Paid on | New year starts |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 31 January 2027 | 2 months | 31 March 2027 | 31 March 2027 | 1 February 2027 |
| 31 January 2027 | 2 months | 31 March 2027 | 1 April 2027 | 1 April 2027 |
| 31 December 2026 | 2 months | 28 February 2027 (February has no 31st) | 1 March 2027 | 1 March 2027 |
| 31 January 2027 | 1 month | 28 February 2027 (February has no 31st) | 28 February 2027 | 1 February 2027 |

## While expired

Cardholders of an expired membership may not purchase merchandise while the tier does not allow shopping while expired, but returns of earlier purchases are never refused because the membership has lapsed.

## Downgrade at renewal

Until the renewal that follows a confirmed downgrade-at-renewal request, the current tier and its privileges continue.

## Retired clauses — no longer in force

- "When the primary member has confirmed a downgrade-at-renewal request, the next renewal is taken at the tier's downgrade target tier and charged that tier's annual fee" — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis.
- "The renewal fee follows the membership fee charging rules." — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis.
